theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_pderiv_iterate_le {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {g : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {d : ℕ} {B : ℤ} (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (j : σ) (hd : degreeOf j g ≤ d) (hB : ∀ (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n g| ≤ B) (k : ℕ) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff n ((⇑(pderiv j))^[k] g)| ≤ ↑k.factorial * 2 ^ d * B

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_divided_wronskian_budget {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [Fintype σ] [Fintype τ] [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq (σ ⊕ τ)] {r₀ n dfirst dlast : ℕ} {a : ℤ} {d : σ ⊕ τ → ℕ} (ha : 1 ≤ a) (Dx : Fin r₀ → List σ) (Dy : Fin r₀ → List τ) (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hdeg : ∀ (h : σ ⊕ τ), degreeOf h P ≤ d h) (hB : ∀ (m : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ), |coeff m P| ≤ a) (hr₀ : r₀ ≤ dlast + 1) (hsum : ∑ h : σ ⊕ τ, d h ≤ (n + 1) * dfirst) (hdf : dlast ≤ dfirst) :
∃ (W : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (c : ℤ), 0 < c ∧ (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin r₀) => (pderivList (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i) ++ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) P).det = C c * W ∧ ∀ (m : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ), |coeff m W| ≤ 2 ^ ((2 * n + 3) * (r₀ * dfirst)) * a ^ r₀

theorem MvPolynomial.height_budget {n r₀ sd dfirst dlast : ℕ} {S a : ℤ} (hr₀ : r₀ ≤ dlast + 1) (hsum : sd ≤ (n + 1) * dfirst) (hdf : dlast ≤ dfirst) (hS1 : 1 ≤ S) (hS : S ≤ 2 ^ sd) (ha : 1 ≤ a) :
↑r₀.factorial * S ^ r₀ * (2 ^ sd * a) ^ r₀ ≤ 2 ^ ((2 * n + 3) * (r₀ * dfirst)) * a ^ r₀

theorem MvPolynomial.card_support_le_two_pow_sum {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] {P : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ → ℕ} (hd : ∀ (h : σ), degreeOf h P ≤ d h) :
↑P.support.card ≤ 2 ^ ∑ h : σ, d h

theorem MvPolynomial.prod_succ_le_two_pow_sum {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] (d : σ → ℕ) :
∏ h : σ, (d h + 1) ≤ 2 ^ ∑ h : σ, d h

theorem MvPolynomial.card_support_le_prod_succ {σ : Type u_1} [Fintype σ] [DecidableEq σ] {R : Type u_2} [CommSemiring R] {P : MvPolynomial σ R} {d : σ → ℕ} (hd : ∀ (h : σ), degreeOf h P ≤ d h) :
P.support.card ≤ ∏ h : σ, (d h + 1)

theorem MvPolynomial.exists_divided_wronskian {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq (σ ⊕ τ)] {r : ℕ} (s : Finset (σ ⊕ τ)) {S B : ℤ} {d : σ ⊕ τ → ℕ} (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (Dx : Fin r → List σ) (Dy : Fin r → List τ) (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hx : ∀ (i : Fin r), ∀ h ∈ List.map Sum.inl (Dx i), h ∈ s) (hy : ∀ (j : Fin r), ∀ h ∈ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j), h ∈ s) (hS : ↑P.support.card ≤ S) (hd : ∀ (h : σ ⊕ τ), degreeOf h P ≤ d h) (hB : ∀ (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n P| ≤ B) :
∃ (W : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ), (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin r) => (pderivList (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i) ++ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) P).det = C ((∏ i : Fin r, ↑(∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i))) h).factorial)) * ∏ j : Fin r, ↑(∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) h).factorial)) * W ∧ ∀ (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n W| ≤ ↑r.factorial * S ^ r * ((2 ^ ∑ h ∈ s, d h) * B) ^ r

theorem MvPolynomial.listFac_append_map {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq (σ ⊕ τ)] (s : Finset (σ ⊕ τ)) (l₁ : List σ) (l₂ : List τ) :
∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (List.map Sum.inl l₁ ++ List.map Sum.inr l₂)) h).factorial = (∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (List.map Sum.inl l₁)) h).factorial) * ∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (List.map Sum.inr l₂)) h).factorial

theorem MvPolynomial.listIdx_map_inr_apply_inl {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} (l : List τ) (x : σ) :
(listIdx (List.map Sum.inr l)) (Sum.inl x) = 0

theorem MvPolynomial.listIdx_map_inl_apply_inr {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} (l : List σ) (y : τ) :
(listIdx (List.map Sum.inl l)) (Sum.inr y) = 0

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_det_le' {σ : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] {S : ℤ} (M : Matrix ι ι (MvPolynomial σ ℤ)) (a b : ι → ℤ) (hS : ∀ (i j : ι), ↑(M i j).support.card ≤ S) (hB : ∀ (i j : ι) (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n (M i j)| ≤ a i * b j) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff n M.det| ≤ ↑(Fintype.card ι).factorial * S ^ Fintype.card ι * ((∏ i : ι, a i) * ∏ j : ι, b j)

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_prod_le' {σ : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [DecidableEq ι] {S : ℤ} (F : ι → MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (β : ι → ℤ) (s : Finset ι) :
(∀ i ∈ s, ↑(F i).support.card ≤ S) → (∀ i ∈ s, ∀ (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n (F i)| ≤ β i) → ∀ (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n (∏ i ∈ s, F i)| ≤ S ^ s.card * ∏ i ∈ s, β i

theorem MvPolynomial.C_listFac_dvd_det_sepFamily {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq (σ ⊕ τ)] {r : ℕ} (s : Finset (σ ⊕ τ)) (Dx : Fin r → List σ) (Dy : Fin r → List τ) (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hx : ∀ (i : Fin r), ∀ h ∈ List.map Sum.inl (Dx i), h ∈ s) (hy : ∀ (j : Fin r), ∀ h ∈ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j), h ∈ s) :
C ((∏ i : Fin r, ↑(∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i))) h).factorial)) * ∏ j : Fin r, ↑(∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) h).factorial)) ∣ (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin r) => (pderivList (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i) ++ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) P).det

theorem MvPolynomial.C_dvd_det_of_dvd_entries {σ : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] (M : Matrix ι ι (MvPolynomial σ ℤ)) (a b : ι → ℤ) (h : ∀ (i j : ι), C (a i * b j) ∣ M i j) :
C ((∏ i : ι, a i) * ∏ j : ι, b j) ∣ M.det

theorem MvPolynomial.listFac_mul_dvd_listFac_append {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset σ) (l₁ l₂ : List σ) :
(∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx l₁) h).factorial) * ∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx l₂) h).factorial ∣ ∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx (l₁ ++ l₂)) h).factorial

theorem MvPolynomial.listIdx_append {σ : Type u_1} (l₁ l₂ : List σ) :
listIdx (l₁ ++ l₂) = listIdx l₁ + listIdx l₂

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_pderivList_le' {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset σ) {g : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {d : σ → ℕ} {B : ℤ} (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (l : List σ) (hs : ∀ h ∈ l, h ∈ s) (hd : ∀ (h : σ), degreeOf h g ≤ d h) (hB : ∀ (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n g| ≤ B) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff n ((pderivList l) g)| ≤ (↑(∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx l) h).factorial) * 2 ^ ∑ h ∈ s, d h) * B

theorem MvPolynomial.listFac_dvd_coeff_pderivList {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (l : List σ) (hs : ∀ h ∈ l, h ∈ s) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
↑(∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx l) h).factorial) ∣ coeff n ((pderivList l) g)

theorem MvPolynomial.listFactor_le {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset σ) (l : List σ) (hs : ∀ h ∈ l, h ∈ s) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) (d : σ → ℕ) (hd : ∀ (h : σ), n h + (listIdx l) h ≤ d h) :
listFactor l n ≤ (∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx l) h).factorial) * 2 ^ ∑ h ∈ s, d h

theorem MvPolynomial.listFac_dvd_listFactor {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset σ) (l : List σ) (hs : ∀ h ∈ l, h ∈ s) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx l) h).factorial ∣ listFactor l n

theorem MvPolynomial.listFactor_eq_factorial_mul {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset σ) (l : List σ) (hs : ∀ h ∈ l, h ∈ s) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
listFactor l n = (∏ h ∈ s, ((listIdx l) h).factorial) * ∏ h ∈ s, (n h + (listIdx l) h).choose ((listIdx l) h)

theorem MvPolynomial.listFactor_eq_prod {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (s : Finset σ) (l : List σ) :
(∀ h ∈ l, h ∈ s) → ∀ (n : σ →₀ ℕ), listFactor l n = ∏ h ∈ s, ∏ i ∈ Finset.range ((listIdx l) h), (n h + 1 + i)

theorem MvPolynomial.listFactor_replicate {σ : Type u_1} (j : σ) (k : ℕ) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
listFactor (List.replicate k j) n = ∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, (n j + 1 + i)

theorem MvPolynomial.coeff_pderivList {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] (l : List σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
coeff n ((pderivList l) g) = ↑(listFactor l n) * coeff (n + listIdx l) g

theorem MvPolynomial.listFactor_cons {σ : Type u_1} (j : σ) (l : List σ) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
listFactor (j :: l) n = (n j + 1) * listFactor l (n + Finsupp.single j 1)

theorem MvPolynomial.listFactor_nil {σ : Type u_1} (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
listFactor [] n = 1

noncomputable def MvPolynomial.listFactor {σ : Type u_1} :
List σ → (σ →₀ ℕ) → ℕ

theorem MvPolynomial.listIdx_cons {σ : Type u_1} (j : σ) (l : List σ) :
listIdx (j :: l) = Finsupp.single j 1 + listIdx l

theorem MvPolynomial.listIdx_nil {σ : Type u_1} :
listIdx [] = 0

noncomputable def MvPolynomial.listIdx {σ : Type u_1} :
List σ → σ →₀ ℕ

theorem MvPolynomial.coeff_pderiv_iterate {σ : Type u_1} {R : Type u_2} [CommRing R] [DecidableEq σ] (j : σ) (k : ℕ) (g : MvPolynomial σ R) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
coeff n ((⇑(pderiv j))^[k] g) = (∏ i ∈ Finset.range k, ↑(n j + 1 + i)) * coeff (n + Finsupp.single j k) g

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_det_sepFamily_le {σ : Type u_1} {τ : Type u_2} [DecidableEq σ] [DecidableEq τ] [DecidableEq (σ ⊕ τ)] {r : ℕ} {S d B : ℤ} (hS1 : 1 ≤ S) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (Dx : Fin r → List σ) (Dy : Fin r → List τ) (hDx : ∀ (i : Fin r), (Dx i).length ≤ ↑i) (hDy : ∀ (j : Fin r), (Dy j).length ≤ ↑j) (P : MvPolynomial (σ ⊕ τ) ℤ) (hS : ↑P.support.card ≤ S) (hd : ∀ (j : σ ⊕ τ), ↑(degreeOf j P) ≤ d) (hB : ∀ (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n P| ≤ B) (n : σ ⊕ τ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff n (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin r) => (pderivList (List.map Sum.inl (Dx i) ++ List.map Sum.inr (Dy j))) P).det| ≤ ↑r.factorial * (S * (d ^ (2 * r) * B)) ^ r

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_det_pderivList_le {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {r L : ℕ} {S d B : ℤ} (hS1 : 1 ≤ S) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (D : Fin r → Fin r → List σ) (P : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (hS : ↑P.support.card ≤ S) (hd : ∀ (j : σ), ↑(degreeOf j P) ≤ d) (hB : ∀ (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n P| ≤ B) (hL : ∀ (i j : Fin r), (D i j).length ≤ L) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff n (Matrix.of fun (i j : Fin r) => (pderivList (D i j)) P).det| ≤ ↑r.factorial * (S * (d ^ L * B)) ^ r

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_mvGenWronskian_le {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {m L : ℕ} {S d B : ℤ} (hS1 : 1 ≤ S) (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (D : Fin m → List σ) (f : Fin m → MvPolynomial σ ℤ) (hS : ∀ (j : Fin m), ↑(f j).support.card ≤ S) (hd : ∀ (i : σ) (j : Fin m), ↑(degreeOf i (f j)) ≤ d) (hB : ∀ (j : Fin m) (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n (f j)| ≤ B) (hL : ∀ (i : Fin m), (D i).length ≤ L) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff n (mvGenWronskian D f)| ≤ ↑m.factorial * (S * (d ^ L * B)) ^ m

theorem MvPolynomial.abs_coeff_pderivList_le {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] {g : MvPolynomial σ ℤ} {d B : ℤ} (hd1 : 1 ≤ d) (hB0 : 0 ≤ B) (hd : ∀ (j : σ), ↑(degreeOf j g) ≤ d) (hB : ∀ (n : σ →₀ ℕ), |coeff n g| ≤ B) (l : List σ) (n : σ →₀ ℕ) :
|coeff n ((pderivList l) g)| ≤ d ^ l.length * B

theorem MvPolynomial.card_support_pderivList_le {σ : Type u_1} [DecidableEq σ] (l : List σ) (g : MvPolynomial σ ℤ) :
((pderivList l) g).support.card ≤ g.support.card
